asked.item: field to attach an .srt caption file when publishing to YouTube

verdict.reason: No sentence says whether Blotato supports attaching an .srt or any caption/subtitle file when publishing to YouTube; the listed YouTube fields (title, privacyStatus, shouldNotifySubscribers, isMadeForKids, containsSyntheticMedia, playlistIds, thumbnailUrl) and the description and tags notes do not cover captions, so this needs the team to confirm.
